headline: Premier League today: How to watch Nottingham Forest v Arsenal, TV channels & live stream
body: How will Nottingham Forest and Arsenal fare today? Here is what to know, including kick-off time, TV channels and live stream options While the true stakes of this season’s Premier League title race won’t be clear until the outcome of Manchester City’s appeal against 114 breaches of financial rules is known, Arsenal have no choice but to focus on catching Enzo Maresca’s pace-setters. City are expected to overcome Ipswich Town at home on Saturday, meaning the Gunners could be six points behind by the time they kick off against Nottingham Forest on Sunday. They can’t afford any slip-ups. Continue reading...
